text: Theo’s childhood fascination with the stars was not merely a hobby but a profound connection to his late mother, an astrophysicist who taught him that the universe was a place of endless wonder. He spent countless nights on the rooftop of their rural home, looking up at the cosmos while remembering her gentle guidance. This deep-seated curiosity drives his actions today, as he seeks to understand the world through the lens of science and memory. Meanwhile, he often reflects on the simple beauty of nature, noting how fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, a poetic reminder of the cycles that connect the earth to the heavens he once studied with such devotion.
